title: Why Do OLED Screens Show Perfect Black? #Shorts
description:
Why do OLED screens show perfect black? Every dot on an OLED screen is its own tiny lamp, a thin organic layer that glows when powered, so for black it simply switches off. A regular LCD TV keeps one big backlight on and twists liquid crystals like tiny blinds to block it, but the blinds leak, so its black is really dark gray. Plus the catch: burn-in.

Explained in 60, podcast edition
